test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The 'Donate - a - Pension' campaign under _____________ scheme, was launched in the 'Iconic Week' celebrations by the Labour Ministry from 7 to 13 March 2022.

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan - Dhan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan:-**

 
 
• It​** **is a **pension scheme** launched by the **Ministry of Labour and Employment** for **unorganized sector workers.**
 
• It aims to provide a monthly pension of **Rs 3000** to workers in the age group of **18-40 years** who have a monthly income of **less than Rs 15,000.**
